verses.ar: وَلَمَّا بُنِيَ ٱلسُّورُ، وَأَقَمْتُ ٱلْمَصَارِيعَ، وَتَرَتَّبَ ٱلْبَوَّابُونَ وَٱلْمُغَنُّونَ وَٱللَّاوِيُّونَ،
verses.kjv: Now it came to pass, when the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and the porters and the singers and the Levites were appointed,
verses.web: Now when the wall was built and I had set up the doors, and the gatekeepers and the singers and the Levites were appointed,
verses.he: וַיְהִ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר נִבְנְתָה֙ הַחֹומָ֔ה וָאַעֲמִ֖יד הַדְּלָתֹ֑ות וַיִּפָּ֥קְד֛וּ הַשֹּׁועֲרִ֥ים וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים וְהַלְוִיִּֽם׃

verses.ar: أَقَمْتُ حَنَانِيَ أَخِي وَحَنَنْيَا رَئِيسَ ٱلْقَصْرِ عَلَى أُورُشَلِيمَ، لِأَنَّهُ كَانَ رَجُلًا أَمِينًا يَخَافُ ٱللهَ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ كَثِيرِينَ.
verses.kjv: That I gave my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the ruler of the palace, charge over Jerusalem: for he [was] a faithful man, and feared God above many.
verses.web: I put my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the governor of the fortress, in charge of Jerusalem; for he was a faithful man and feared God above many.
verses.he: וָאֲצַוֶּ֞ה אֶת־חֲנָ֣נִי אָחִ֗י וְאֶת־חֲנַנְיָ֛ה שַׂ֥ר הַבִּירָ֖ה עַל־יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם כִּי־הוּא֙ כְּאִ֣ישׁ אֱמֶ֔ת וְיָרֵ֥א אֶת־הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים מֵרַבִּֽים׃

verses.ar: وَقُلْتُ لَهُمَا: «لَا تُفْتَحْ أَبْوَابُ أُورُشَلِيمَ حَتَّى تَحْمَى ٱلشَّمْسُ. وَمَا دَامُوا وُقُوفًا فَلْيُغْلِقُوا ٱلْمَصَارِيعَ وَيُقْفِلُوهَا. وَأُقِيمَ حِرَاسَاتٌ مِنْ سُكَّانِ أُورُشَلِيمَ، كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ عَلَى حِرَاسَتِهِ، وَكُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مُقَابِلَ بَيْتِهِ».
verses.kjv: And I said unto them, Let not the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun be hot; and while they stand by, let them shut the doors, and bar [them:] and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, every one in his watch, and every one [to be] over against his house.
verses.web: I said to them, “Don’t let the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun is hot; and while they stand guard, let them shut the doors, and you bar them; and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, everyone in his watch, with everyone near his house.”
verses.he: *וַיֹּאמֶר (וָאֹמַ֣ר) לָהֶ֗ם לֹ֣א יִפָּֽתְח֞וּ שַׁעֲרֵ֤י יְרוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ עַד־חֹ֣ם הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ וְעַ֨ד הֵ֥ם עֹמְדִ֛ים יָגִ֥יפוּ הַדְּלָתֹ֖ות וֶאֱחֹ֑זוּ וְהַעֲמֵ֗יד מִשְׁמְרֹות֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם אִ֚ישׁ בְּמִשְׁמָרֹ֔ו וְאִ֖ישׁ נֶ֥גֶד בֵּיתֹֽו׃

verses.ar: وَكَانَتِ ٱلْمَدِينَةُ وَاسِعَةَ ٱلْجَنَابِ وَعَظِيمَةً، وَٱلشَّعْبُ قَلِيلًا فِي وَسَطِهَا، وَلَمْ تَكُنِ ٱلْبُيُوتُ قَدْ بُنِيَتْ.
verses.kjv: Now the city [was] large and great: but the people [were] few therein, and the houses [were] not builded.
verses.web: Now the city was wide and large; but the people were few therein, and the houses were not built.
verses.he: וְהָעִ֞יר רַחֲבַ֤ת יָדַ֙יִם֙ וּגְדֹולָ֔ה וְהָעָ֥ם מְעַ֖ט בְּתֹוכָ֑הּ וְאֵ֥ין בָּתִּ֖ים בְּנוּיִֽם׃

verses.ar: فَأَلْهَمَنِي إِلَهِي أَنْ أَجْمَعَ ٱلْعُظَمَاءَ وَٱلْوُلَاةَ وَٱلشَّعْبَ لِأَجْلِ ٱلِٱنْتِسَابِ. فَوَجَدْتُ سِفْرَ ٱنْتِسَابِ ٱلَّذِينَ صَعِدُوا أَوَّلًا وَوَجَدْتُ مَكْتُوبًا فِيهِ:
verses.kjv: ¶ And my God put into mine heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be reckoned by genealogy. And I found a register of the genealogy of them which came up at the first, and found written therein,
verses.web: My God put into my heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be listed by genealogy. I found the book of the genealogy of those who came up at the first, and I found this written in it:
verses.he: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן אֱלֹהַי֙ אֶל־לִבִּ֔י וָאֶקְבְּצָ֞ה אֶת־הַחֹרִ֧ים וְאֶת־הַסְּגָנִ֛ים וְאֶת־הָעָ֖ם לְהִתְיַחֵ֑שׂ וָֽאֶמְצָ֗א סֵ֤פֶר הַיַּ֙חַשׂ֙ הָעֹולִ֣ים בָּרִאשֹׁונָ֔ה וָאֶמְצָ֖א כָּת֥וּב בֹּֽו׃ פ

verses.ar: هَؤُلَاءِ هُمْ بَنُو ٱلْكُورَةِ ٱلصَّاعِدُونَ مِنْ سَبْيِ ٱلْمَسْبِيِّينَ ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَاهُمْ نَبُوخَذْنَصَّرُ مَلِكُ بَابِلَ وَرَجَعُوا إِلَى أُورُشَلِيمَ وَيَهُوذَا، كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ إِلَى مَدِينَتِهِ.
verses.kjv: These [are] the children of the province, that went up out of the captivity, of those that had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and came again to Jerusalem and to Judah, every one unto his city;
verses.web: These are the children of the province who went up out of the captivity of those who had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and who returned to Jerusalem and to Judah, everyone to his city,
verses.he: אֵ֣לֶּה ׀ בְּנֵ֣י הַמְּדִינָ֗ה הָעֹלִים֙ מִשְּׁבִ֣י הַגֹּולָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶגְלָ֔ה נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֖ר מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל וַיָּשׁ֧וּבוּ לִֽירוּשָׁלַ֛͏ִם וְלִיהוּדָ֖ה אִ֥ישׁ לְעִירֹֽו׃

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ جَاءُوا مَعَ زَرُبَّابِلَ، يَشُوعُ، نَحَمْيَا، عَزَرْيَا، رَعَمْيَا، نَحَمَانِي، مُرْدَخَايُ، بِلْشَانُ، مِسْفَارَثُ بِغْوَايُ، نَحُومُ، وَبَعْنَةُ. عَدَدُ رِجَالِ شَعْبِ إِسْرَائِيلَ:
verses.kjv: Who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. The number, [I say], of the men of the people of Israel [was this;]
verses.web: who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, and Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:
verses.he: הַבָּאִ֣ים עִם־זְרֻבָּבֶ֗ל יֵשׁ֡וּעַ נְחֶמְיָ֡ה עֲ֠זַרְיָה רַֽעַמְיָ֨ה נַחֲמָ֜נִי מָרְדֳּכַ֥י בִּלְשָׁ֛ן מִסְפֶּ֥רֶת בִּגְוַ֖י נְח֣וּם בַּעֲנָ֑ה מִסְפַּ֕ר אַנְשֵׁ֖י עַ֥ם יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ ס

verses.ar: بَنُو فَرْعُوشَ أَلْفَانِ وَمِئَةٌ وَٱثْنَانِ وَسَبْعُونَ.
verses.kjv: The children of Parosh, two thousand an hundred seventy and two.
verses.web: The children of Parosh: two thousand one hundred seventy-two.
verses.he: בְּנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔שׁ אַלְפַּ֕יִם מֵאָ֖ה וְשִׁבְעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ ס

verses.ar: بَنُو شَفَطْيَا ثَلَاثُ مِئَةٍ وَٱثْنَانِ وَسَبْعُونَ.
verses.kjv: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy and two.
verses.web: The children of Shephatiah: three hundred seventy-two.
verses.he: בְּנֵ֣י שְׁפַטְיָ֔ה שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵאֹ֖ות שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ ס

verses.ar: بَنُو آرَحَ سِتُّ مِئَةٍ وَٱثْنَانِ وَخَمْسُونَ.
verses.kjv: The children of Arah, six hundred fifty and two.
verses.web: The children of Arah: six hundred fifty-two.
verses.he: בְּנֵ֣י אָרַ֔ח שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֹ֖ות חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ ס

verses.ar: بَنُو فَحَثَ مُوآبَ مِنْ بَنِي يَشُوعَ وَيُوآبَ أَلْفَانِ وَثَمَانُ مِئَةٍ وَثَمَانِيَةَ عَشَرَ.
verses.kjv: The children of Pahath-moab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand and eight hundred [and] eighteen.
verses.web: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab: two thousand eight hundred eighteen.
verses.he: בְּנֵֽי־פַחַ֥ת מֹואָ֛ב לִבְנֵ֥י יֵשׁ֖וּעַ וְיֹואָ֑ב אַלְפַּ֕יִם וּשְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵאֹ֖ות שְׁמֹנָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃ ס

verses.ar: بَنُو عِيلَامَ أَلْفٌ وَمِئَتَانِ وَأَرْبَعَةٌ وَخَمْسُونَ.
verses.kjv: The children of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.
verses.web: The children of Elam: one thousand two hundred fifty-four.
verses.he: בְּנֵ֣י עֵילָ֔ם אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃ ס

verses.ar: بَنُو زَتُّو ثَمَانُ مِئَةٍ وَخَمْسَةٌ وَأَرْبَعُونَ.
verses.kjv: The children of Zattu, eight hundred forty and five.
verses.web: The children of Zattu: eight hundred forty-five.
verses.he: בְּנֵ֣י זַתּ֔וּא שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵאֹ֖ות אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ ס

verses.ar: بَنُو زَكَّايَ سَبْعُ مِئَةٍ وَسِتُّونَ.
verses.kjv: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and threescore.
verses.web: The children of Zaccai: seven hundred sixty.
verses.he: בְּנֵ֣י זַכָּ֔י שְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֹ֖ות וְשִׁשִּֽׁים׃ ס

verses.ar: بَنُو بِنُّويَ سِتُّ مِئَةٍ وَثَمَانِيَةٌ وَأَرْبَعُونَ.
verses.kjv: The children of Binnui, six hundred forty and eight.
verses.web: The children of Binnui: six hundred forty-eight.
verses.he: בְּנֵ֣י בִנּ֔וּי שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֹ֖ות אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ ס

verses.ar: بَنُو بَابَايَ سِتُّ مِئَةٍ وَثَمَانِيَةٌ وَعِشْرُونَ.
verses.kjv: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty and eight.
verses.web: The children of Bebai: six hundred twenty-eight.
verses.he: בְּנֵ֣י בֵבָ֔י שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֹ֖ות עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ ס

verses.ar: بَنُو عَزْجَدَ أَلْفَانِ وَثَلَاثُ مِئَةٍ وَٱثْنَانِ وَعِشْرُونَ.
verses.kjv: The children of Azgad, two thousand three hundred twenty and two.
verses.web: The children of Azgad: two thousand three hundred twenty-two.
verses.he: בְּנֵ֣י עַזְגָּ֔ד אַלְפַּ֕יִם שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵאֹ֖ות עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ ס

verses.ar: بَنُو أَدُونِيقَامَ سِتُّ مِئَةٍ وَسَبْعَةٌ وَسِتُّونَ.
verses.kjv: The children of Adonikam, six hundred threescore and seven.
verses.web: The children of Adonikam: six hundred sixty-seven.
verses.he: בְּנֵי֙ אֲדֹ֣נִיקָ֔ם שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֹ֖ות שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָֽה׃ ס

verses.ar: بَنُو بِغْوَايَ أَلْفَانِ وَسَبْعَةٌ وَسِتُّونَ.
verses.kjv: The children of Bigvai, two thousand threescore and seven.
verses.web: The children of Bigvai: two thousand sixty-seven.
verses.he: בְּנֵ֣י בִגְוָ֔י אַלְפַּ֖יִם שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָֽה׃ ס

verses.ar: بَنُو عَادِينَ سِتُّ مِئَةٍ وَخَمْسَةٌ وَخَمْسُونَ.
verses.kjv: The children of Adin, six hundred fifty and five.
verses.web: The children of Adin: six hundred fifty-five.
verses.he: בְּנֵ֣י עָדִ֔ין שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֹ֖ות חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ ס

verses.ar: بَنُو أَطِّيرَ لِحَزَقِيَّا ثَمَانِيَةٌ وَتِسْعُونَ.
verses.kjv: The children of Ater of Hezekiah, ninety and eight.
verses.web: The children of Ater: of Hezekiah, ninety-eight.
verses.he: בְּנֵֽי־אָטֵ֥ר לְחִזְקִיָּ֖ה תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ ס

verses.ar: بَنُو حَشُومَ ثَلَاثُ مِئَةٍ وَثَمَانِيَةٌ وَعِشْرُونَ.
verses.kjv: The children of Hashum, three hundred twenty and eight.
verses.web: The children of Hashum: three hundred twenty-eight.
verses.he: בְּנֵ֣י חָשֻׁ֔ם שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵאֹ֖ות עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ ס

verses.ar: بَنُو بِيصَايَ ثَلَاثُ مِئَةٍ وَأَرْبَعَةٌ وَعِشْرُونَ.
verses.kjv: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty and four.
verses.web: The children of Bezai: three hundred twenty-four.
verses.he: בְּנֵ֣י בֵצָ֔י שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵאֹ֖ות עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃ ס

verses.ar: بَنُو حَارِيفَ مِئَةٌ وَٱثْنَا عَشَرَ.
verses.kjv: The children of Hariph, an hundred and twelve.
verses.web: The children of Hariph: one hundred twelve.
verses.he: בְּנֵ֣י חָרִ֔יף מֵאָ֖ה שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ ס

verses.ar: بَنُو جِبْعُونَ خَمْسَةٌ وَتِسْعُونَ.
verses.kjv: The children of Gibeon, ninety and five.
verses.web: The children of Gibeon: ninety-five.
verses.he: בְּנֵ֥י גִבְעֹ֖ון תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ ס

verses.ar: رِجَالُ بَيْتِ لَحْمَ وَنَطُوفَةَ مِئَةٌ وَثَمَانِيَةٌ وَثَمَانُونَ.
verses.kjv: The men of Beth-lehem and Netophah, an hundred fourscore and eight.
verses.web: The men of Bethlehem and Netophah: one hundred eighty-eight.
verses.he: אַנְשֵׁ֤י בֵֽית־לֶ֙חֶם֙ וּנְטֹפָ֔ה מֵאָ֖ה שְׁמֹנִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ ס

verses.ar: رِجَالُ عَنَاثُوثَ مِئَةٌ وَثَمَانِيَةٌ وَعِشْرُونَ.
verses.kjv: The men of Anathoth, an hundred twenty and eight.
verses.web: The men of Anathoth: one hundred twenty-eight.
verses.he: אַנְשֵׁ֣י עֲנָתֹ֔ות מֵאָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ ס

verses.ar: رِجَالُ بَيْتِ عَزْمُوتَ ٱثْنَانِ وَأَرْبَعُونَ.
verses.kjv: The men of Beth-azmaveth, forty and two.
verses.web: The men of Beth Azmaveth: forty-two.
verses.he: אַנְשֵׁ֥י בֵית־עַזְמָ֖וֶת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ ס

verses.ar: رِجَالُ قَرْيَةِ يَعَارِيمَ كَفِيرَةَ وَبَئِيرُوتَ سَبْعُ مِئَةٍ وَثَلَاثةٌ وَأَرْبَعُونَ.
verses.kjv: The men of Kirjath-jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred forty and three.
verses.web: The men of Kiriath Jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth: seven hundred forty-three.
verses.he: אַנְשֵׁ֨י קִרְיַ֤ת יְעָרִים֙ כְּפִירָ֣ה וּבְאֵרֹ֔ות שְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֹ֖ות אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ ס

verses.ar: رِجَالُ ٱلرَّامَةِ وَجَبَعَ سِتُّ مِئَةٍ وَوَاحِدٌ وَعِشْرُونَ.
verses.kjv: The men of Ramah and Geba, six hundred twenty and one.
verses.web: The men of Ramah and Geba: six hundred twenty-one.
verses.he: אַנְשֵׁ֤י הָֽרָמָה֙ וָגָ֔בַע שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֹ֖ות עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאֶחָֽד׃ ס

verses.ar: رِجَالُ مِخْمَاسَ مِئَةٌ وَٱثْنَانِ وَعِشْرُونَ.
verses.kjv: The men of Michmas, an hundred and twenty and two.
verses.web: The men of Michmas: one hundred twenty-two.
verses.he: אַנְשֵׁ֣י מִכְמָ֔ס מֵאָ֖ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ ס

verses.ar: رِجَالُ بَيْتِ إِيلَ وعَايَ مِئَةٌ وَثَلَاثةٌ وَعِشْرُونَ.
verses.kjv: The men of Beth-el and Ai, an hundred twenty and three.
verses.web: The men of Bethel and Ai: one hundred twenty-three.
verses.he: אַנְשֵׁ֤י בֵֽית־אֵל֙ וְהָעָ֔י מֵאָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ ס

verses.ar: رِجَالُ نَبُو ٱلْأُخْرَى ٱثْنَانِ وَخَمْسُونَ.
verses.kjv: The men of the other Nebo, fifty and two.
verses.web: The men of the other Nebo: fifty-two.
verses.he: אַנְשֵׁ֥י נְבֹ֛ו אַחֵ֖ר חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ ס

verses.ar: بَنُو عِيلَامَ ٱلْآخَرِ أَلْفٌ وَمِئَتَانِ وَأَرْبَعَةٌ وَخَمْسُونَ.
verses.kjv: The children of the other Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.
verses.web: The children of the other Elam: one thousand two hundred fifty-four.
verses.he: בְּנֵי֙ עֵילָ֣ם אַחֵ֔ר אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃ ס

verses.ar: بَنُو حَارِيمَ ثَلَاثُ مِئَةٍ وَعِشْرُونَ.
verses.kjv: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.
verses.web: The children of Harim: three hundred twenty.
verses.he: בְּנֵ֣י חָרִ֔ם שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵאֹ֖ות וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃ ס

verses.ar: بَنُو أَرِيحَا ثَلَاثُ مِئَةٍ وَخَمْسَةٌ وَأَرْبَعُونَ.
verses.kjv: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty and five.
verses.web: The children of Jericho: three hundred forty-five.
verses.he: בְּנֵ֣י יְרֵחֹ֔ו שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵאֹ֖ות אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ ס

verses.ar: بَنُو لُودَ بَنُو حَادِيدَ وَأُونُو سَبْعُ مِئَةٍ وَوَاحِدٌ وَعِشْرُونَ.
verses.kjv: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty and one.
verses.web: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono: seven hundred twenty-one.
verses.he: בְּנֵי־לֹד֙ חָדִ֣יד וְאֹונֹ֔ו שְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֹ֖ות וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאֶחָֽד׃ ס

verses.ar: بَنُو سَنَاءَةَ ثَلَاثَةُ آلَافٍ وَتِسْعُ مِئَةٍ وَثَلَاثُونَ.
verses.kjv: The children of Senaah, three thousand nine hundred and thirty.
verses.web: The children of Senaah: three thousand nine hundred thirty.
verses.he: בְּנֵ֣י סְנָאָ֔ה שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵאֹ֖ות וּשְׁלֹשִֽׁים׃ פ

verses.ar: أَمَّا ٱلْكَهَنَةُ: فَبَنُو يَدْعِيَا مِنْ بَيْتِ يَشُوعَ تِسْعُ مِئَةٍ وَثَلَاثَةٌ وَسَبْعُونَ.
verses.kjv: ¶ The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy and three.
verses.web: The priests: The children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua: nine hundred seventy-three.
verses.he: הַֽכֹּהֲנִ֑ים בְּנֵ֤י יְדַֽעְיָה֙ לְבֵ֣ית יֵשׁ֔וּעַ תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵאֹ֖ות שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּשְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ ס

verses.ar: بَنُو إِمِّيرَ أَلْفٌ وَٱثْنَانِ وَخَمْسُونَ.
verses.kjv: The children of Immer, a thousand fifty and two.
verses.web: The children of Immer: one thousand fifty-two.
verses.he: בְּנֵ֣י אִמֵּ֔ר אֶ֖לֶף חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ ס

verses.ar: بَنُو فَشْحُورَ أَلْفٌ وَمِئَتَانِ وَسَبْعَةٌ وَأَرْبَعُونَ.
verses.kjv: The children of Pashur, a thousand two hundred forty and seven.
verses.web: The children of Pashhur: one thousand two hundred forty-seven.
verses.he: בְּנֵ֣י פַשְׁח֔וּר אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָֽה׃ ס

verses.ar: بَنُو حَارِيمَ أَلْفٌ وَسَبْعَةَ عَشَرَ.
verses.kjv: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.
verses.web: The children of Harim: one thousand seventeen.
verses.he: בְּנֵ֣י חָרִ֔ם אֶ֖לֶף שִׁבְעָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃ פ

verses.ar: أَمَّا ٱللَّاوِيُّونَ: فَبَنُو يَشُوعَ، لِقَدْمِيئِيلَ مِنْ بَنِي هُودُويَا أَرْبَعَةٌ وَسَبْعُونَ.
verses.kjv: ¶ The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, [and] of the children of Hodevah, seventy and four.
verses.web: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, of the children of Hodevah: seventy-four.
verses.he: הַלְוִיִּ֑ם בְּנֵֽי־יֵשׁ֧וּעַ לְקַדְמִיאֵ֛ל לִבְנֵ֥י לְהֹודְוָ֖ה שִׁבְעִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃ ס

verses.ar: اَلْمُغَنُّونَ: بَنُو آسَافَ مِئَةٌ وَثَمَانِيَةٌ وَأَرْبَعُونَ.
verses.kjv: ¶ The singers: the children of Asaph, an hundred forty and eight.
verses.web: The singers: the children of Asaph: one hundred forty-eight.
verses.he: הַֽמְשֹׁרְרִ֑ים בְּנֵ֣י אָסָ֔ף מֵאָ֖ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ ס

verses.ar: اَلْبَوَّابُونَ: بَنُو شَلُّومَ، بَنُو أَطِيرَ، بَنُو طَلْمُونَ، بَنُو عَقُّوبَ، بَنُو حَطِيطَا، بَنُو شُوبَايَ مِئَةٌ وَثَمَانِيَةٌ وَثَلَاثُونَ.
verses.kjv: ¶ The porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, an hundred thirty and eight.
verses.web: The gatekeepers: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai: one hundred thirty-eight.
verses.he: הַשֹּֽׁעֲרִ֗ים בְּנֵֽי־שַׁלּ֤וּם בְּנֵֽי־אָטֵר֙ בְּנֵֽי־טַלְמֹ֣ן בְּנֵֽי־עַקּ֔וּב בְּנֵ֥י חֲטִיטָ֖א בְּנֵ֣י שֹׁבָ֑י מֵאָ֖ה שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ ס

verses.ar: اَلنَّثِينِيمُ: بَنُو صِيحَا، بَنُو حَسُوفَا، بَنُو طَبَاعُوتَ،
verses.kjv: ¶ The Nethinims: the children of Ziha, the children of Hashupha, the children of Tabbaoth,
verses.web: The temple servants: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,
verses.he: הַנְּתִינִ֑ים בְּנֵי־צִחָ֥א בְנֵי־חֲשֻׂפָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י טַבָּעֹֽות׃

verses.ar: بَنُو قِيرُوسَ، بَنُو سِيعَا، بَنُو فَادُونَ
verses.kjv: The children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,
verses.web: the children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,
verses.he: בְּנֵי־קֵירֹ֥ס בְּנֵי־סִיעָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י פָדֹֽון׃

verses.ar: وَبَنُو لَبَانَةَ وَبَنُو حَجَابَا، بَنُو سَلْمَايَ،
verses.kjv: The children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Shalmai,
verses.web: the children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Salmai,
verses.he: בְּנֵי־לְבָנָ֥ה בְנֵי־חֲגָבָ֖ה בְּנֵ֥י שַׁלְמָֽי׃

verses.ar: بَنُو حَانَانَ، بَنُو جَدِيلَ، بَنُو جَاحَرَ،
verses.kjv: The children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,
verses.web: the children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,
verses.he: בְּנֵי־חָנָ֥ן בְּנֵי־גִדֵּ֖ל בְּנֵי־גָֽחַר׃

verses.ar: بَنُو رَآيَا، بَنُو رَصِينَ وَبَنُو نَقُودَا،
verses.kjv: The children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda,
verses.web: the children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda,
verses.he: בְּנֵי־רְאָיָ֥ה בְנֵי־רְצִ֖ין בְּנֵ֥י נְקֹודָֽא׃

verses.ar: بَنُو جَزَامَ، بَنُو عَزَا، بَنُو فَاسِيحَ،
verses.kjv: The children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Phaseah,
verses.web: the children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Paseah,
verses.he: בְּנֵי־גַזָּ֥ם בְּנֵי־עֻזָּ֖א בְּנֵ֥י פָסֵֽחַ׃

verses.ar: بَنُو بِيسَايَ، بَنُو مَعُونِيمَ، بَنُو نَفِيشَسِيمَ،
verses.kjv: The children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephishesim,
verses.web: the children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephushesim,
verses.he: בְּנֵי־בֵסַ֥י בְּנֵי־מְעוּנִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י *נְפוּשְׁסִים (נְפִֽישְׁסִֽים)׃

verses.ar: بَنُو بَقْبُوقَ، بَنُو حَقُوفَا، بَنُو حَرْحُورَ،
verses.kjv: The children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,
verses.web: the children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,
verses.he: בְּנֵי־בַקְבּ֥וּק בְּנֵֽי־חֲקוּפָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י חַרְחֽוּר׃

verses.ar: بَنُو بَصْلِيتَ، بَنُو مَحِيدَا، بَنُو حَرْشَا،
verses.kjv: The children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,
verses.web: the children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,
verses.he: בְּנֵי־בַצְלִ֥ית בְּנֵֽי־מְחִידָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י חַרְשָֽׁא׃

verses.ar: بَنُو بَرْقُوسَ، بَنُو سِيسَرَا، بَنُو تَامَحَ،
verses.kjv: The children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Tamah,
verses.web: the children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Temah,
verses.he: בְּנֵי־בַרְקֹ֥וס בְּֽנֵי־סִֽיסְרָ֖א בְּנֵי־תָֽמַח׃

verses.ar: بَنُو نَصِيحَ، بَنُو حَطِيفَا.
verses.kjv: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.
verses.web: the children of Neziah, and the children of Hatipha.
verses.he: בְּנֵ֥י נְצִ֖יחַ בְּנֵ֥י חֲטִיפָֽא׃

verses.ar: بَنُو عَبِيدِ سُلَيْمَانَ: بَنُو سُوطَايَ، بَنُو سُوفَرَثَ، بَنُو فَرِيدَا،
verses.kjv: ¶ The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,
verses.web: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,
verses.he: בְּנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה בְּנֵי־סֹוטַ֥י בְּנֵי־סֹופֶ֖רֶת בְּנֵ֥י פְרִידָֽא׃

verses.ar: بَنُو يَعْلَا، بَنُو دَرْقُونَ، بَنُو جَدِّيلَ،
verses.kjv: The children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,
verses.web: the children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,
verses.he: בְּנֵי־יַעְלָ֥א בְנֵי־דַרְקֹ֖ון בְּנֵ֥י גִדֵּֽל׃

verses.ar: بَنُو شَفَطْيَا، بَنُو حَطِّيلَ، بَنُو فُوخَرَةِ ٱلظِّبَاءِ، بَنُو آمُونَ.
verses.kjv: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Amon.
verses.web: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth Hazzebaim, and the children of Amon.
verses.he: בְּנֵ֧י שְׁפַטְיָ֣ה בְנֵֽי־חַטִּ֗יל בְּנֵ֛י פֹּכֶ֥רֶת הַצְּבָיִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י אָמֹֽון׃

verses.ar: كُلُّ ٱلنَّثِينِيمِ وَبَنِي عَبِيدِ سُلَيْمَانَ ثَلَاثُ مِئَةٍ وَٱثْنَانِ وَتِسْعُونَ.
verses.kjv: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon’s servants, [were] three hundred ninety and two.
verses.web: All the temple servants and the children of Solomon’s servants were three hundred ninety-two.
verses.he: כָּל־הַ֨נְּתִינִ֔ים וּבְנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵאֹ֖ות תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ פ

verses.ar: وَهَؤُلَاءِ هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ صَعِدُوا مِنْ تَلِّ مِلْحٍ وَتَلِّ حَرْشَا، كَرُوبُ وَأَدُونُ وَإِمِّيرُ، وَلَمْ يَسْتَطِيعُوا أَنْ يُبَيِّنُوا بُيُوتَ آبَائِهِمْ وَنَسْلَهُمْ هَلْ هُمْ مِنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ:
verses.kjv: And these [were] they which went up [also] from Tel-melah, Tel-haresha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer: but they could not shew their father’s house, nor their seed, whether they [were] of Israel.
verses.web: These were those who went up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer; but they could not show their fathers’ houses, nor their offspring, whether they were of Israel:
verses.he: וְאֵ֗לֶּה הָעֹולִים֙ מִתֵּ֥ל מֶ֙לַח֙ תֵּ֣ל חַרְשָׁ֔א כְּר֥וּב אַדֹּ֖ון וְאִמֵּ֑ר וְלֹ֣א יָכְל֗וּ לְהַגִּ֤יד בֵּית־אֲבֹותָם֙ וְזַרְעָ֔ם אִ֥ם מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽם׃

verses.ar: بَنُو دَلَايَا، بَنُو طُوبِيَّا، بَنُو نَقُودَا سِتُّ مِئَةٍ وَٱثْنَانِ وَأَرْبَعُونَ.
verses.kjv: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred forty and two.
verses.web: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda: six hundred forty-two.
verses.he: בְּנֵי־דְלָיָ֥ה בְנֵֽי־טֹובִיָּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י נְקֹודָ֑א שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֹ֖ות וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ ס

verses.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلْكَهَنَةِ: بَنُو حَبَابَا، بَنُو هَقُّوصَ، بَنُو بَرْزِلَّايَ، ٱلَّذِي أَخَذَ ٱمْرَأَةً مِنْ بَنَاتِ بَرْزِلَايَ ٱلْجِلْعَادِيِّ وَتَسَمَّى بِٱسْمِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai, which took [one] of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite to wife, and was called after their name.
verses.web: Of the priests: the children of Hobaiah, the children of Hakkoz, the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.
verses.he: וּמִן־הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים בְּנֵ֥י חֳבַיָּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י הַקֹּ֑וץ בְּנֵ֣י בַרְזִלַּ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָ֠קַח מִבְּנֹ֞ות בַּרְזִלַּ֤י הַגִּלְעָדִי֙ אִשָּׁ֔ה וַיִּקָּרֵ֖א עַל־שְׁמָֽם׃

verses.ar: هَؤُلَاءِ فَحَصُوا عَنْ كِتَابَةِ أَنْسَابِهِمْ فَلَمْ تُوجَدْ، فَرُذِلُوا مِنَ ٱلْكَهَنُوتِ.
verses.kjv: These sought their register [among] those that were reckoned by genealogy, but it was not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.
verses.web: These searched for their genealogical records, but couldn’t find them. Therefore they were deemed disqualified and removed from the priesthood.
verses.he: אֵ֗לֶּה בִּקְשׁ֧וּ כְתָבָ֛ם הַמִּתְיַחְשִׂ֖ים וְלֹ֣א נִמְצָ֑א וַיְגֹֽאֲל֖וּ מִן־הַכְּהֻנָּֽה׃

verses.ar: وَقَالَ لَهُمُ ٱلتَّرْشَاثَا أَنْ لَا يَأْكُلُوا مِنْ قُدْسِ ٱلْأَقْدَاسِ حَتَّى يَقُومَ كَاهِنٌ لِلْأُورِيمِ وَٱلتُّمِّيمِ.
verses.kjv: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood [up] a priest with Urim and Thummim.
verses.web: The governor told them not to eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to minister with Urim and Thummim.
verses.he: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר הַתִּרְשָׁ֙תָא֙ לָהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יֹאכְל֖וּ מִקֹּ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים עַ֛ד עֲמֹ֥ד הַכֹּהֵ֖ן לְאוּרִ֥ים וְתוּמִּֽים׃

verses.ar: كُلُّ ٱلْجُمْهُورِ مَعًا أَرْبَعُ رِبَوَاتٍ وَأَلْفَانِ وَثَلَاثُ مِئَةٍ وَسِتُّونَ،
verses.kjv: ¶ The whole congregation together [was] forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,
verses.web: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty,
verses.he: כָּל־הַקָּהָ֖ל כְּאֶחָ֑ד אַרְבַּ֣ע רִבֹּ֔וא אַלְפַּ֖יִם שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאֹ֥ות וְשִׁשִּֽׁים׃

verses.ar: فَضْلًا عَنْ عَبِيدِهِمْ وَإِمَائِهِمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَانُوا سَبْعَةَ آلَافٍ وَثَلَاثَ مِئَةٍ وَسَبْعَةً وَثَلَاثِينَ. وَلَهُمْ مِنَ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ وَٱلْمُغَنِّيَاتِ مِئَتَانِ وَخَمْسَةٌ وَأَرْبَعُونَ.
verses.kjv: Beside their manservants and their maidservants, of whom [there were] seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and they had two hundred forty and five singing men and singing women.
verses.web: in addition to their male servants and their female servants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven. They had two hundred forty-five singing men and singing women.
verses.he: מִ֠לְּבַד עַבְדֵיהֶ֤ם וְאַמְהֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ אֵ֔לֶּה שִׁבְעַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵאֹ֖ות שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וְשִׁבְעָ֑ה וְלָהֶ֗ם מְשֹֽׁרֲרִים֙ וּמְשֹׁ֣רֲרֹ֔ות מָאתַ֖יִם וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ ס

verses.ar: وَخَيْلُهُمْ سَبْعُ مِئَةٍ وَسِتَّةٌ وَثَلَاثُونَ، وَبِغَالُهُمْ مِئَتَانِ وَخَمْسَةٌ وَأَرْبَعُونَ،
verses.kjv: Their horses, seven hundred thirty and six: their mules, two hundred forty and five:
verses.web: Their horses were seven hundred thirty-six; their mules, two hundred forty-five;

verses.ar: وَٱلْجِمَالُ أَرْبَعُ مِئَةٍ وَخَمْسَةٌ وَثَلَاثُونَ، وَٱلْحَمِيرُ سِتَّةُ آلَافٍ وَسَبْعُ مِئَةٍ وَعِشْرُونَ.
verses.kjv: [Their] camels, four hundred thirty and five: six thousand seven hundred and twenty asses.
verses.web: their camels, four hundred thirty-five; their donkeys, six thousand seven hundred twenty.
verses.he: גְּמַלִּ֕ים אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֹ֖ות שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֑ה ס חֲמֹרִ֕ים שֵׁ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֹ֖ות וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃

verses.ar: وَٱلْبَعْضُ مِنْ رُؤُوسِ ٱلْآبَاءِ أَعْطَوْا لِلْعَمَلِ. ٱلتَّرْشَاثَا أَعْطَى لِلْخَزِينَةِ أَلْفَ دِرْهَمٍ مِنَ ٱلذَّهَبِ، وَخَمْسِينَ مِنْضَحَةً، وَخَمْسَ مِئَةٍ وَثَلَاثِينَ قَمِيصًا لِلْكَهَنَةِ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And some of the chief of the fathers gave unto the work. The Tirshatha gave to the treasure a thousand drams of gold, fifty basons, five hundred and thirty priests’ garments.
verses.web: Some from among the heads of fathers’ households gave to the work. The governor gave to the treasury one thousand darics of gold, fifty basins, and five hundred thirty priests’ garments.
verses.he: וּמִקְצָת֙ רָאשֵׁ֣י הֽ͏ָאָבֹ֔ות נָתְנ֖וּ לַמְּלָאכָ֑ה הַתִּרְשָׁ֜תָא נָתַ֣ן לָאֹוצָ֗ר זָהָ֞ב דַּרְכְּמֹנִ֥ים אֶ֙לֶף֙ מִזְרָקֹ֣ות חֲמִשִּׁ֔ים כָּתְנֹות֙ כֹּֽהֲנִ֔ים שְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֹֽות׃

verses.ar: وَٱلْبَعْضُ مِنْ رُؤُوسِ ٱلْآبَاءِ أَعْطَوْا لِخَزِينَةِ ٱلْعَمَلِ رِبَوَتَيْنِ مِنَ ٱلذَّهَبِ، وَأَلْفَيْنِ وَمِئَتَيْ مَنًا مِنَ ٱلْفِضَّةِ.
verses.kjv: And [some] of the chief of the fathers gave to the treasure of the work twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand and two hundred pound of silver.
verses.web: Some of the heads of fathers’ households gave into the treasury of the work twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand two hundred minas of silver.
verses.he: וּמֵֽרָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽאָבֹ֗ות נָֽתְנוּ֙ לְאֹוצַ֣ר הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה זָהָ֕ב דַּרְכְּמֹונִ֖ים שְׁתֵּ֣י רִבֹּ֑ות וְכֶ֕סֶף מָנִ֖ים אַלְפַּ֥יִם וּמָאתָֽיִם׃

verses.ar: وَمَا أَعْطَاهُ بَقِيَّةُ ٱلشَّعْبِ سِتَّ رِبْوَاتٍ مِنَ ٱلذَّهَبِ، وَأَلْفَيْ مَنًا مِنَ ٱلْفِضَّةِ، وَسَبْعَةً وَسِتِّينَ قَمِيصًا لِلْكَهَنَةِ.
verses.kjv: And [that] which the rest of the people gave [was] twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand pound of silver, and threescore and seven priests’ garments.
verses.web: That which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand darics of gold, plus two thousand minas of silver, and sixty-seven priests’ garments.
verses.he: וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתְנוּ֮ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית הָעָם֒ זָהָ֗ב דַּרְכְּמֹונִים֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י רִבֹּ֔וא וְכֶ֖סֶף מָנִ֣ים אַלְפָּ֑יִם וְכָתְנֹ֥ת כֹּֽהֲנִ֖ים שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָֽה׃ פ

verses.ar: وَأَقَامَ ٱلْكَهَنَةُ وَاللَّاوِيُّونَ وَٱلْبَوَّابُونَ وَٱلْمُغَنُّونَ وَبَعْضُ ٱلشَّعْبِ وَٱلنَّثِينِيمُ وَكُلُّ إِسْرَائِيلَ فِي مُدُنِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: So the priests, and the Levites, and the porters, and the singers, and [some] of the people, and the Nethinims, and all Israel, dwelt in their cities; and when the seventh month came, the children of Israel [were] in their cities.
verses.web: So the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, some of the people, the temple servants, and all Israel lived in their cities. When the seventh month had come, the children of Israel were in their cities.
verses.he: וַיֵּשְׁב֣וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֡ם וְהַשֹּׁועֲרִים֩ וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֨ים וּמִן־הָעָ֧ם וְהַנְּתִינִ֛ים וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּעָרֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּגַּע֙ הַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י וּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּעָרֵיהֶֽם׃
